description: Meter installation confirmation emitted by the infra-utility-connect meter_install Pregel cell. Records the installed meter's serial / model / calibration certificate (G2 IPFS-pinned) and the installer's witness signature (G3 minLength 1, installer DID MUST differ from submitter DID). Cited by utilityActivation as a prerequisite. Per ADR-2605250900 + gates G2, G3.

approvalId.description: Parent providerApproval this installation acts upon.

meterSerialNumber.description: Provider-recognized unique serial of the installed meter unit.

meterModelReference.description: Provider-published meter model reference (e.g. model number). Free-text product names disallowed.

calibrationCertificateIpfsCid.description: G2: IPFS CID of the meter's calibration certificate (factory + jurisdiction-required field-verification).

installerWitnessSignature.description: G3: signed by the installer's witness DID; MUST differ from the parent serviceRequest.submitterDid.

initialReadingValue.description: Initial meter reading at install time (raw integer in meter's native unit; unit context held by meterModelReference).

installerDid.description: DID of the installer. MUST differ from the parent serviceRequest.submitterDid.

providerEmployeeReference.description: Opaque provider-internal employee reference. PII filter applies.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over (meterInstallationId + meterSerialNumber + installedAt + calibrationCertificateIpfsCid).
